newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra to invite bids for airports this mth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra to invite bids for airports this mth.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey said on Tuesday the government would call this month for tenders for three of the airports it plans to privatise.
"The tender process for the sale of leases of Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth airports will commence shortly," Fahey said in a statement.

"Advertisements calling for the registration of expressions of interest in these airports are expected to be published in national and international newspapers within the next fortnight," the minister said.
But the privatisation of Adelaide airport would be deferred while the government looked at building a new terminal combining international and domestic services for all airlines, he said.
The study would take until early 1997, after which the government would again consider the timing of that airport's privatisation.
The government plans to privatise all airports -- including Sydney's, eventually -- by selling long leases.
The sale of Sydney's Kingsford Smith airport, Australia's busiest, has been deferred while the government determines where to build a second airport in Sydney.
